name: Possumkin · Gremlet #49
description:
An opossum joey that plays dead whenever it's surprised, then peeks to see if it worked.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Possumkin in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
